properties.evidence: Option ③ of this idea, the reader — which requirements lose their reason when a decision is re-opened — is built here: reason_to_exist on a governed requirement, and reasons_to_exist_lost on a change walk seeded at (or breaking) the Decision. The other options (② the default, ④ populating lineage, ⑤ the detector) are not built, and the idea's status is left for Anthony. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
